scheme_name: Free Coaching for SCs, OBCs and beneficiaries of PM CARES Children Scheme
description:
The Free Coaching for SCs, OBCs and beneficiaries of PM CARES Children Scheme is an initiative launched by the Government of India to provide educational support to marginalized communities. 

This scheme was officially launched on 26th February 2021. 

It aims to enhance the educational opportunities for Scheduled Castes (SCs), Other Backward Classes (OBCs), and children who are beneficiaries of the PM CARES Fund. 

The primary objective of this scheme is to provide free coaching for competitive examinations. 

The scheme specifically targets students preparing for various competitive exams such as the Union Public Service Commission (UPSC), Staff Selection Commission (SSC), and other similar examinations. 

The government has set a target to provide coaching to approximately 50,000 students annually under this scheme. 

The Free Coaching scheme is designed to ensure that students from disadvantaged backgrounds have equal access to quality education and coaching facilities. 

The benefits of the scheme include free coaching classes, study materials, and other necessary resources. 

Each selected student is entitled to receive financial assistance of up to INR 50,000 for coaching fees and related expenses. 

The scheme also covers the cost of study materials and other educational resources required for competitive exam preparation. 

In addition to financial support, the scheme aims to provide mentorship and guidance from experienced faculty members. 

Eligibility for the scheme is restricted to students belonging to SC and OBC categories. 

Beneficiaries of the PM CARES Fund are also eligible for this scheme. 

Applicants must be Indian citizens and should be pursuing coaching for competitive examinations. 

There is no specific age limit mentioned for applicants under this scheme. 

However, candidates must have completed their higher secondary education or equivalent. 

The income criteria for eligibility stipulates that the annual family income should not exceed INR 8 lakhs. 

The application process for the Free Coaching scheme is straightforward. 

Interested candidates must visit the official website of the Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment. 

The application form can be downloaded from the website. 

Applicants are required to fill in the necessary details accurately. 

Documents required for the application include a caste certificate, income certificate, and proof of enrollment in a coaching institute. 

Once the application form is completed, it must be submitted to the designated authority in the respective state or union territory. 

The timeline for the application process is generally announced on the official website. 

Applications are usually accepted once a year, with specific deadlines communicated through public notifications. 

The disbursement of funds is typically done in two installments. 

The first installment is released upon the selection of candidates. 

The second installment is released after the submission of progress reports by the coaching institutes. 

The implementing authority for this scheme is the Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment. 

The National Scheduled Castes Finance and Development Corporation (NSFDC) is also involved in the execution of the scheme. 

For any queries or assistance, candidates can contact the Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment at their official helpline number. 

The scheme has received positive feedback from various stakeholders. 

It has been noted that the initiative helps bridge the educational gap for SC and OBC students. 

The scheme is part of a broader effort by the Indian government to promote social equity and inclusion. 

The government has allocated a budget of INR 200 crores for the implementation of this scheme over the next five years. 

The Free Coaching scheme is expected to empower thousands of students from marginalized communities. 

It aims to enhance their chances of success in competitive examinations. 

The initiative reflects the government's commitment to providing equal opportunities in education. 

The scheme also aligns with the Sustainable Development Goals set by the United Nations. 

By focusing on education for all, the government aims to reduce inequalities in society. 

The Free Coaching for SCs, OBCs and beneficiaries of PM CARES Children Scheme is a significant step towards achieving educational equity. 

It is designed to provide not just financial assistance but also emotional and academic support. 

The coaching institutes selected for this scheme are required to meet certain quality standards. 

They must have experienced faculty and a proven track record of success in coaching for competitive exams. 

The government conducts regular audits and assessments of these institutes to ensure compliance. 

This ensures that the beneficiaries receive high-quality coaching and support. 

The scheme has the potential to transform the lives of many students. 

It opens doors to higher education and better job opportunities. 

By equipping students with the necessary skills and knowledge, the scheme aims to foster a more inclusive society. 

The Free Coaching initiative is a testament to the Indian government's focus on education as a tool for empowerment. 

It reflects a holistic approach to addressing the challenges faced by marginalized communities. 

The scheme is expected to create a ripple effect in society by uplifting entire families and communities. 

As students succeed in competitive exams, they can contribute positively to the economy and society. 

In conclusion, the Free Coaching for SCs, OBCs and beneficiaries of PM CARES Children Scheme is a comprehensive initiative. 

It provides financial support and quality coaching to those who need it the most. 

The scheme is a vital part of India's commitment to social justice and educational equity. 

It is designed to ensure that every child has the opportunity to realize their potential. 

The government continues to monitor and improve the scheme to maximize its impact. 

This initiative stands as a beacon of hope for many aspiring students across the country. 

Through this scheme, the government aims to create a more equitable and prosperous future for all.
